implementation_strategy: Execute confirmatory main run (N=300 paired intents) using hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: one shared initial generation call per intent (used for both baseline and guarded episodes) and at most one guarded repair call when deterministic verifier fails. Deterministic verifier and all validation/flagging code run locally (CPU). All prompts, parser templates, verifier logic, seeds, and executor inputs are frozen and archived. No human review or manual adjudication is used.
task_manifest_strategy: Pre-generate 300 paired intents stratified by complexity (100 low / 100 medium / 100 high) using intent_synthesis_v1; assign stable integer IDs 1..300; freeze manifest and hash before main run.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Publish and freeze prompt templates: initial_generation_prompt_v1, repair_prompt_template_v1 (single repair allowed per adapter), structured-syntax-parser_v1, device-template-mapping_v1. Verifier and automated-flag rules are version-locked and unit-tested on negative and positive controls.
randomisation_plan: Within each complexity stratum (100 tasks), randomize task execution order using deterministic seed 20260830; paired tasks remain together. Strata composition fixed (100/100/100).
caching_plan: Cache deterministic verifier outputs, structured-parser results, and final artifact hashes. Model outputs and raw logs are archived per-episode; no external resource dependencies. Cached artifacts used only for audit/reproducibility, not to alter execution decisions.
failure_recovery_plan: Per preregistration/execution contract: if both pipeline calls for a pair fail due to provider/infrastructure outage, exclude the pair and log reason. If a single call fails, retain pair under 'complete_pair_primary' rule (sensitivity analysis treats single-call failure as failure). Halt entire run and report if >20% attempted pairs are excluded. No manual retries beyond adapter's maximum_attempts_per_call.
result_schema: Episode-level record per paired_binary_episode_v1: {task_id, complexity_stratum, shared_initial_candidate_output, baseline_episode:{model_call_id, model_output, parser_extraction, verifier_result, automated_flag}, guarded_episode:{initial_candidate_ref, repair_call_id_optional, model_output_optional, parser_extraction_optional, verifier_result, automated_flag}, exclusions_and_failure_reasons, hashes, timestamps}. Primary analysis dataset: one row per analyzable pair after exclusion rules.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated API calls: between 300 (best-case no repairs) and 600 (worst-case repair for every pair). Planned estimate: 450 model calls. Maximum_model_calls enforced by adapter = task_count * 2 = 600. Verifier and parsing run on CPU; no local GPU required. Wall-clock execution target: under 7 days given hosted API availability and batching; abort/halt criteria per preregistration if outages exceed thresholds.
